validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED. IGAT 10 (خط دهم سراسری گاز, the 'loop'/لوپ line) is a real, well-documented Iranian gas trunkline. The gem.wiki page rests on a single 2014 Iran Daily forecast ('IGAT-10 to come online in December', 28 Oct 2014) — thin support on its own — but multiple independent sources confirm the physical line. CLASSIFICATION — CONFIRMED gas transmission trunk (a large-diameter reinforcement/loop line for the central corridor, supplying Isfahan and central provinces previously fed by IGAT 1/2/4). Not gathering/process/plant-internal; not oil/NGL. DUPLICATE — none: it is the only IGAT 10 in the 31-row Iran roster; not a segment double-count of another PID (distinct Kangan→Isfahan loop). GulfPub's 'IGAT 10 | Bushehr Province → Saveh, 56 in, 393 km' is the same physical line (fuzzy endpoint/length; GulfPub's Capacity_mmcfd=300 is a placeholder, ignored). SPEC — length 632 km and capacity 2472.03 MMcf/d both CORROBORATED: naftema.com and Persian industry sources give 632 km and 70 MMcm/d, and 70 MMcm/d × 35.3147 = 2472.03 MMcf/d exactly (i.e. GEM's oddly precise figure is just the metric 70 MMcm/d converted). digital-oil-gas-map.com lists 597 km (as-built route length) — minor. NOTE English Wikipedia repeats GEM's exact '2,472.03 MMcf/d' and the same Iran Daily cite, so it is circular, NOT independent — excluded. Diameter blank in GEM; both independent sources give 56 in (staged as a fill). ATTRIBUTION caveats: End location 'Tiran' does not match the sourced terminus (Pol Kaleh CS, Lanjan county, Esfahan) — province correct, city likely wrong; operator/owner: gas trunklines are NIGC/IGTC (Ministry of Petroleum ultimate owner is defensible), GulfPub's 'NIOC' is the oil company and is wrong for a gas line. StartYear1=2014 rests only on the 2014 forecast article while compressor stations (e.g. Pol Kaleh) came online ~2023-2024, so 2014 is at best partial first-gas.

Existing GEM value confirmed, not changed. naftema.com states 70 million m3/day; 70 MMcm/d = 2472.03 MMcf/d (×35.3147), which is exactly the GEM figure. Ref was missing; added.

Existing GEM value confirmed. naftema.com gives 632 km (matches GEM). digital-oil-gas-map.com gives 597 km as-built route length — minor variance, likely digitized-route vs nominal length; 632 km is the commonly cited nominal figure. Ref was missing; added.

Operating status supported: naftema.com lists it among Iran's operating national trunklines (loop line supplying Isfahan/central provinces), and Persian news reports the terminal Pol Kaleh compressor station reaching operation. Caveat: full line commissioned in stages over ~a decade; first gas cited for 2014 but later sections operational ~2023-2024. Tier medium (line-level operation well-supported; exact all-sections date not pinned).

routes.corridor_desc: The line runs ~632 km NNE from the South Pars/Kangan gas hub on the Bushehr coast, up through the Zagros in Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad Province (past Pataveh/Dena), into Esfahan Province, terminating at the Pol Kaleh compressor station in Lanjan county south of Isfahan city (feeding on toward Dehghan). Three compressor stations along the way. Bound is corridor-level: the three named nodes (Kangan, Pataveh, Lanjan/Pol Kaleh) and three provinces are well-sourced; the exact digitized alignment is not (a paid GIS dataset exists but coordinates were not extracted).
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent sources: naftema.com gives the route as Kangan → Pataveh → Isfahan; digital-oil-gas-map.com names the Kangan compressor station (Jam, Bushehr) start and Pol Kaleh compressor station (Lanjan, Esfahan) end. Coordinates are the real published locations of those named towns/nodes (Kangan city; Pataveh, Dena; Zarrin Shahr/Lanjan), NOT digitized pipeline vertices — no coordinate was fabricated. This corrects the sheet's placeholder endpoints (start 'Asia' / end 'Asia', with a Wikimedia image as RouteNotes) and flags that the sheet's End city 'Tiran' disagrees with the sourced terminus at Lanjan/Pol Kaleh (both in Esfahan Province).

summary: P0440 IGAT 10 confirmed real, correctly classified gas trunk, no duplicate; length 632 km + capacity 2472.03 MMcf/d (=70 MMcm/d) corroborated by 2 independent sources; blank Diameter filled 56 in. Caveats: End city 'Tiran' likely wrong (terminus is Lanjan/Pol Kaleh, Esfahan), StartYear1=2014 weakly sourced, operator is NIGC/IGTC not NIOC.
